sentences.text_target: It is a very dark night in the city.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈvɛri dɑːrk naɪt ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
sentences.text_native: C'est une nuit très sombre dans la ville.

sentences.text_target: A young man walks home alone.
sentences.text_native: Un jeune homme rentre chez lui à pied tout seul.

sentences.text_target: He wants to arrive safely.
sentences.text_native: Il veut arriver sain et sauf.

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, he hears a loud noise in the street.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsʌdənli, hi hɪərz ə laʊd nɔɪz ɪn ðə striːt/
sentences.text_native: Soudain, il entend un grand bruit dans la rue.

sentences.text_target: Someone shouts for help very loudly.
sentences.text_native: Quelqu'un appelle à l'aide très fort.

sentences.text_target: The man stops and looks around him.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə mæn stɑːps ænd lʊks əˈraʊnd ɪm/
sentences.text_native: L'homme s'arrête et regarde autour de lui.

sentences.text_target: He feels great fear because of the danger.
sentences.phonetic: /hi fiːlz greɪt fɪər bɪˈkʌz əv ðə ˈdeɪndʒər/
sentences.text_native: Il ressent une grande peur à cause du danger.

sentences.text_target: He needs to hide quickly.
sentences.text_native: Il doit se cacher rapidement.

sentences.text_target: He moves behind a tall brick wall.
sentences.phonetic: /hi muːvz bɪˈhaɪnd ə tɔːl brɪk wɔːl/
sentences.text_native: Il se met à l'abri derrière un grand mur en briques.

sentences.text_target: He tries to breathe very quietly.
sentences.text_native: Il essaie de respirer très discrètement.

sentences.text_target: His heart beats fast in his chest.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz hɑːrt biːts fɑːst ɪn hɪz tʃɛst/
sentences.text_native: Son cœur bat la chamade dans sa poitrine.

sentences.text_target: He puts his hand inside his pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts hɪz hænd ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz ˈpɑːkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il met la main dans sa poche.

sentences.text_target: He reaches for his phone.
sentences.text_native: Il attrape son téléphone.

sentences.text_target: He presses the emergency button.
sentences.text_native: Il appuie sur le bouton d'urgence.

sentences.text_target: He calls the correct emergency number.
sentences.text_native: Il compose le bon numéro d'urgence.

sentences.text_target: A professional operator answers the call.
sentences.text_native: Un(e) opérateur(trice) professionnel(le) répond à l'appel.

sentences.text_target: The man speaks in slow English.
sentences.text_native: L'homme parle anglais lentement.

sentences.text_target: He explains the dangerous situation clearly.
sentences.text_native: Il explique clairement la situation dangereuse.

sentences.text_target: The operator tells him to wait a minute.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈɑːpəreɪtər tɛlz hɪm tuː weɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt/
sentences.text_native: L'opérateur lui demande de patienter un instant.

sentences.text_target: He waits quietly behind the wall.
sentences.text_native: Il attend tranquillement derrière le mur.

sentences.text_target: After a short time, he sees bright lights.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər ə ʃɔːrt taɪm, hi siːz braɪt laɪts/
sentences.text_native: Après un court instant, il aperçoit des lumières vives.

sentences.text_target: Red and blue lights flash in the dark street.
sentences.phonetic: /rɛd ænd bluː laɪts flæʃ ɪn ðə dɑːrk striːt/
sentences.text_native: Des gyrophares rouges et bleus clignotent dans la rue sombre.

sentences.text_target: Police cars arrive very fast.
sentences.text_native: Les voitures de police arrivent très vite.

sentences.text_target: Police officers get out of the vehicle.
sentences.phonetic: /pəˈliːs ˈɔːfɪsərz gɛt aʊt əv ðə ˈviːhɪkl/
sentences.text_native: Les agents de police sortent du véhicule.

sentences.text_target: They look around the area carefully.
sentences.text_native: Ils inspectent les environs avec attention.

sentences.text_target: The man steps out and speaks to an officer.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə mæn stɛps aʊt ænd spiːks tuː ən ˈɔːfɪsər/
sentences.text_native: L'homme sort de sa cachette et parle à un agent.

sentences.text_target: The police catch the thief.
sentences.text_native: La police attrape le voleur.

sentences.text_target: Finally, the danger goes away.
sentences.text_native: Finalement, le danger est écarté.

sentences.text_target: The man feels a great sense of relief.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə mæn fiːlz ə greɪt sɛns əv rɪˈliːf/
sentences.text_native: L'homme ressent un immense soulagement.

sentences.text_target: Now he is completely safe at home.
sentences.phonetic: /naʊ hi ɪz kəmˈpliːtli seɪf æt hoʊm/
sentences.text_native: Maintenant, il est totalement en sécurité chez lui.
